obstacles._note: Obstacle warnings while walking (camera/obstacle/*, camera mode 'walk'). PROTOTYPE, opt-in, a SUPPLEMENT to the cane: it never says the way is clear or safe. OFF until the walk-trial go/no-go passes (docs/agent/research/OFFLINE_VISION_AND_OBSTACLES_2026-11-02.md section 5). Every number below is an uncalibrated first guess: tune on recorded walks.

model._install: NOT bundled. Add ONE file: YOLOX-Nano ONNX (Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX, Apache-2.0, COCO, ~3.7 MB, input float32 [1,3,416,416] BGR 0..255 NO normalisation, output [1,3549,85] = cx,cy,w,h (raw, undecoded), objectness, 80 class scores, already sigmoided). Official release asset: https://github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX/releases/download/0.1.1rc0/yolox_nano.onnx (if that URL 404s: export yolox_nano.pth from the same release with tools/export_onnx.py WITHOUT --decode_in_inference, opset 11). Put it at <externalFiles>/ondevice/obstacles/yolox_nano.onnx (adb push), or <files>/obstacles/yolox_nano.onnx, or app/src/main/assets/obstacles/yolox_nano.onnx. YOLOX-Tiny (yolox_tiny.onnx, ~20 MB, same 416 input) drops in with no code change. Do NOT use Ultralytics YOLO (AGPL).

bands._note: Box height as a fraction of the upright frame (times the class's scale, below), or a box that reaches the bottom edge. near ~ within about two steps, medium ~ a few steps, far ~ farther. Bands, never metres.

haptics._note: Waveform timings in ms: pause, on, pause, on ... Strength = length/count (near longest). Direction = rhythm: ahead = even pulses, left = long then short, right = short then long. One motor cannot point, so the rhythm is the direction.

phrases.disclaimer: Walking mode. I may miss things, so keep using your cane.
phrases.stopped: Stopped watching. I may have missed things.
phrases.blocked: I can't see ahead, so I've stopped watching.
phrases.timeout: I've been watching a while and will stop now. I may have missed things.
phrases.notInstalled: The obstacle model isn't installed on this phone, so I can't warn you about obstacles.
phrases.loadFailed: I couldn't load the obstacle model, so I can't warn you about obstacles.
phrases.disabled: Obstacle warnings aren't switched on yet.
phrases.label: Watching ahead

classes._note: COCO class name -> what is said, its priority group (vehicle, motorbike, bicycle, person, pole, animal, other: lower is more urgent), and a size scale (a smaller thing looks smaller at the same distance, so its box height counts for more). Unlisted COCO classes are ignored. Goats come out as sheep/dog/cow, so animals are only ever 'Animal'.
